claim: Section 3, Now: "each applicant's W-9, Preferred Tenant Agreement and $500 deposit is prepared by hand"
problem: Scope and wording are both wrong against the only cited source. /about-us attaches the rental application + W-9 + Preferred Tenant Agreement + $500 refundable deposit to the Preferred Tenants List (a waiting list for move-in dates beyond the posted availability), not to every applicant, and describes the $500 as a refundable holding deposit, not the standard security deposit. 'Prepared by hand' is not stated anywhere I could find and sits awkwardly against the same page's statement that 'all paperwork can be processed via the internet'. The audit present-tense states a manual per-applicant paperwork bottleneck that the business's own site does not support.
fix: Rewrite to match the source, e.g. "AppFolio already runs the resident portal, yet availability is still a hand-maintained text page marked © 2022, and joining the Preferred Tenants List still means a rental application, a W-9, a Preferred Tenant Agreement and a $500 refundable deposit, with no published online path on the public site". Drop 'each applicant' and 'prepared by hand', or label the staff-time assumption explicitly as your inference. If the manual-paperwork premise is load-bearing for opportunity 3, get it from a discovery call, not from the site.

claim: "about 350 units in about a dozen downtown buildings, 25+ years in one city" with the sources line attributing '25 years, New Brunswick only' to the NJBIZ PDF
problem: The unit count is supported by the cited August 2022 NJBIZ reprint, but that reprint does not say the company has 25+ years in one city (it says the two founders have been 'business partner[s] of the last 25 years'). The 25-years and New-Brunswick-only facts actually come from /about-us. Also, ~350 units is a four-year-old figure presented as current in an audit dated November 2026.
fix: Attribute correctly: NJBIZ PDF for 'approximately 350 units under management' (add: as of the August 29, 2022 profile), /about-us for 'over 25 years' and 'ONLY operates in the City of New Brunswick'. Say 'roughly 350 units (2022 figure)' in the body.

claim: Section 2, Now: "hours are Monday–Friday 9–5, closed weekends"
problem: The cited /location-map page only lists 'M–F: 9:00 AM–5:00 PM'; it never states that the office is closed on weekends. Weekend closure is an inference from the absence of weekend hours (the profile's Google Maps note is a separate, unlinked source).
fix: Either cite the Google Business Profile line ('Closed — Opens 9 AM Mon') alongside /location-map, or phrase as 'hours published as Monday–Friday 9:00 AM–5:00 PM, with no weekend hours listed'.

claim: Section 3, Now: "AppFolio holds units, leases and payments"
problem: Supported only indirectly (the 'Powered by AppFolio Property Manager' badge and the AppFolio resident-portal links that handle rent payment). That AppFolio is the record for units and leases specifically is a reasonable inference from it being the property-management system, not something a page states.
fix: Add a short hedge: 'AppFolio is the system of record — the site footer and resident portal are AppFolio, and residents pay rent through it (per our read of your site)'.

claim: Founder email: "the pricing page lists a rent for every unit and then says 'CALL FOR DETAILS'"
problem: Minor ordering inaccuracy: 'CALL FOR DETAILS' is the banner directly above the rent list, not a step after it. Several listed units also carry a rent but are marked 'Not Available' (276 Hamilton jr. studio, all three 76 Louis layouts), so 'a rent for every unit' slightly overstates current availability.
fix: Rephrase: "the pricing page lists a rent for each unit type but leads with 'CALL FOR DETAILS', and several units are already marked not available".

claim: Section 1, Impact: "Each extra 12-month lease is worth $14,520–$50,400 a year at your published rents"
problem: Arithmetic is correct (12 × $1,210 to 12 × $4,200), but the low end is anchored on the $1,210 jr. studio at 276 Hamilton Street, which the same page marks 'Not Available', and the figure is gross rent, not contribution. Presented without either caveat next to a '+4.8% scheduled visits' benchmark it reads as a harder number than it is.
fix: Say 'gross annual rent of $14,520–$50,400 depending on unit type (the $1,210 jr. studio is currently marked not available, so the realistic floor is higher)'.

claim: "Connects to your Duda site" and "your Duda site" framing generally
problem: Correct but unlabelled: Duda is identified from page-source fingerprints (static.cdn-website.com/dm runtime scripts, dmAPI, irp.cdn-website.com asset host), not from any vendor statement on the site. The profile flagged this as an inference; the audit states it as fact.
fix: Keep the claim (the fingerprints are conclusive enough for a pitch) but add 'looks like a Duda build' or footnote the basis, so it can't be challenged as insider knowledge in the meeting.
